notes: Official stage page/PDF/overview report 23 km. Naturkartan segment labels and computed official GPX total are about 21.8 km. OSM computes about 22.267 km. E1 reports 17.7 km because it omits Hjo-Mullsjön.
Both official Naturkartan GPX files are stored reverse to official Hjo-Baståsen order.
Some source labels use Mullsjö while the intended stage split is the Mullsjön/Stämmorna lake area, not Mullsjö municipality.
Naturkartan/Grillplatser maps a fire/rest point, while the Hjoåns dalgång reserve page says no fire.
Older official PDF/KML clues mention Rödåkra about 1 km west and bus line 405, but 2026-04-29 transit research could not find a current Rödåkra stop and line 405 returned stale/404 evidence.
Official sources mention Hedsmossen pump and Kärrabo spring, but official text still recommends carrying water and recent planning notes flag Hedsmossen iron-rich water.
